title: [Run] Improve Win32 icon loading
author: dsrivastavv
summary: This old PowerToys Run performance thread began with Win32 icon-loading latency, but its own measurements were later withdrawn or redirected to other query costs.
next_action: Ask for a current user-visible latency case; maintainer profiling should follow only if it still reproduces.

confidence.rationale: The need for current evidence follows directly from the thread's conflicting historical measurements.

judgment.rationale: The public discussion does not contain reliable current measurements or a stable dominant bottleneck, so a code fix cannot be chosen from the historical thread.
evidence: The initial report attributes first-query lag to IShellItem icon loading.
Later measurements estimated icon loading as a minority of total time and then explicitly called the investigation unreliable.
Several competing ideas were discussed: deferred rendering, smaller icons, UWP caching, and query changes.
The last comment asks for status but supplies no current measurement.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for a current user-visible latency case; maintainer profiling should follow only if it still reproduces.

fix_assessment.rationale: The thread does not establish a current bug or a reliable root cause, and its historical profiling conclusions conflict.

issue_context.summary: This old PowerToys Run performance thread began with Win32 icon-loading latency, but its own measurements were later withdrawn or redirected to other query costs.
known_information: The issue concerns first-query responsiveness for Win32 application results.
Image caching reduced repeated-load work but not necessarily total query latency.
inferences: Current plugin and rendering changes may have invalidated the 2020 performance balance.
issue_context.analysis: Current impact must be established before spending maintainer profiling time on one of several old hypotheses.
initial_investigation: Read all performance measurements and the explicit retraction in the thread.
Confirmed the current Run tree still has separate program repository, icon, and result rendering paths.

information_gaps.information: The current visible delay, query, and whether text results appear before icons.

actions.label: Confirm current first-query icon delay

comment.body:
The historical thread contains useful experiments, but its profiling conclusions were later marked unreliable and several different bottlenecks were proposed.

Please confirm the following on the current stable PowerToys release.
1. The PowerToys version and a query that consistently shows the delay.
2. Whether result text appears before icons or the entire result list is delayed.
3. An approximate delay or short screen recording with sensitive result names hidden.

This will determine whether maintainers should profile icon loading, plugin query time, or rendering.
